description:
Activate Ashnod's Altar by sacrificing Haunt of the Dead Marshes, adding {C}{C}.
When Haunt of the Dead Marshes dies, Pitiless Plunderer triggers, creating a Treasure token.
Activate the Treasure by tapping and sacrificing it, adding {B}.
Activate Haunt of the Dead Marshes by paying {2}{B}, returning it from your graveyard to the battlefield.
Repeat.
